description: This file defines the EditableText class, which extends the Text interface to provide methods for editing textual content and interacting with the system clipboard, using the Atspi library.

classes.name: EditableText
classes.description: A class that extends Text to support editing operations such as copy, cut, delete, insert, paste, and set text contents, interacting with the system clipboard.

methods.name: copyText
methods.description: Copies a range of text into the system clipboard.

methods.name: cutText
methods.description: Cuts a range of text from the object and copies it into the clipboard.

methods.name: deleteText
methods.description: Deletes a range of text from the object without copying it.

methods.name: insertText
methods.description: Inserts new text at a specified position within the text object.

methods.name: pasteText
methods.description: Pastes text from the system clipboard into the text object at a specified position.

methods.name: setTextContents
methods.description: Replaces the entire text content with a new string.
